name: Event budget variance
audience: Anyone planning a wedding, funeral, graduation, or family celebration with a fixed cash amount.
summary: Set a planned amount for each event cost and record what you actually pay.
description: Variance is actual minus plan. The workbook totals both columns and shows which lines ran over. It is built for a 40-person family celebration, and the categories can be renamed.
benefits: See the overrun on each line
Keep vendors and notes beside the number
Protect a contingency instead of spending it first
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
